<description>
## Generatetomany

First approach was to create a `generatetomany` rpc call. That approach can be seen here https://github.com/polespinasa/bitcoin/pull/3

## Generateblock
Modifies `generateblock` to allow a user to set multiple outputs in the coinbase transaction. If an empty set is provided, the block will be empty. If no set of transactions is provided, the block will mine the mempool. If a set of transactions is provided only that set of txs will be mined.

```
$./bitcoin-cli -rpcport=18443 generateblock bcrt1qw6qkj8wtw5hraxwxjp08m4aymkntms3yhqyacj
{
  "hash": "7359a3ed7af0f18f4016e6cb29193bd787a2452c584781135c585d5204b9ec5b"
}

$ ./bitcoin-cli -rpcport=18443 generateblock '["bcrt1qal6p633hvwz2yp5mav0qy7u2az8gkn2xywnj6v", "bcrt1qvr3qgyhw6y0e0zj97v0j5yc40xtpea4wqj0g43"]'
{
  "hash": "6db028454b26d6667dd6df45be2772844121fb44f86433f6bbfbafa429974684"
}

$ ./bitcoin-cli -rpcport=18443 generateblock '["bcrt1qal6p633hvwz2yp5mav0qy7u2az8gkn2xywnj6v", "bcrt1qvr3qgyhw6y0e0zj97v0j5yc40xtpea4wqj0g43"]' []

{
  "hash": "33e2ddc52546ddb0edf28bef5b295ee8fbd487b8aca19c97018467e2477877df"
}

```

<commits>
63c12e4494 rpc: Expand generateblock transactions argument options

Allow generateblock to mine empty blocks, blocks with a pre-set of transactions or
mine transactions from the mempool.

1393adef36 test: expand generateblock test coverage

ade479c5c7 rpc: add multiple outputs to generateblock

Allow to add multiple outputs to the coinbase transaction when using generateblock.
The block reward, previously burned is now splited in equal parts among the different outputs.
If the reward is odd, the first N outputs get an extra sat. Being N = total_reward % num_outputs.

ab1484c306 test: add custom outputs test coverage for generateblock

Also remove now unecesary raw outputs from other tests consuming
the generateblock rpc.

d9c4dcbb71 rpc: add custom split reward to generateblock

Allows to specify custom rewards for each output of the coinbase transaction.
Previously the reward was split into equal parts.

Co-authored-by: Biel <bicaru2@gmail.com>

f77be43ea4 test: add test coverage for custom reward of generateblock

a6ce1200ea Add release notes

Co-authored-by: Biel <bicaru2@gmail.com>

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..348ba599e3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/doc/release-notes-32468.md
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+# RPC
+
+- The RPC `generateblock` takes `output` as an argument. This argument allows to specify where to distribute the reward of the block. It takes an address, a descriptor or a list of multiple addresses and descriptors. Optionally, each entry can be an object `{"address/descriptor": amount}` to assign that output a fixed reward in satoshis; the remaining block reward is then split, in equal parts, among all provided outputs. If `output` is not set, the reward is burnt in an OP_RETURN output. The reward is split, in equal parts, among all addresses and descriptors provided.
+
+- The argument `transactions` is optional in `generateblock`. If no set of transactions is provided, the ones from the mempool are used. If an empty set is provided, an empty block is mined. If a set of transactions is provided, that set of transactions is mined.
